limitations: The producer registry is intentionally empty, so the V1 baseline has no positive certification path and proves only fail-closed non-issuance plus dormant boundary integrity.
No motive-five, corrective-family, P010, or other methodology validator is implemented by this contract.
The generic dormant layer does not define or deep-inspect a future analyzed subject's domain fields; a reviewed producer must provide complete exact subject provenance extraction and verification.

The dormant source-provenance representation checks enum-shaped source classes, but each future producer must separately lock its exact protected principles, source classifications, protected sources, and verifier semantics.

Future subject-content integrity depends on the reviewed producer binding all authoritative subject fields and rejecting mutation or substitution; the infrastructure currently exercises no subject callback.
Nested family proofs are supported only as dormant exact live certificate references; no recursive family-composition semantics or producer currently exists.

The first producer requires positive success, mutation, subject substitution, callback/provenance, nested-proof, weak-reference cleanup, copy/serialization, manual-origin, and attestation-reuse adversarial tests before activation.

A future contract delta may be required if the first genuine producer cannot satisfy the current exact-type, weak-reference, provenance, or protected-principle assumptions; that approval boundary is not resolved by this baseline.
Certification has logical same-process API integrity; Python privacy is not hostile same-interpreter isolation.
Reflective access to private module state, object.__setattr__, import hooks, or arbitrary code execution in the Kernel interpreter is outside the claimed threat model.
Certificate authority is designed to remain bound to exact live in-memory objects; pickle is rejected and generic serialization cannot mint proof.
The contract does not provide durable cross-process certification or cryptographic authenticity.
The existing structural-invalidity certification system is separate and does not establish positive family validity.
P003 motive/corrective search themes are context only and do not establish positive family validity.
VALIDATED-INTERNAL-FAMILY-CONTRACT-V1 is a logical development baseline and is not physically protected.
